The best shooters on PS Plus

PS Plus has shooters of every kind, from fast, gory first-person blasters to cinematic adventures, co-op chaos and a couple of PS2 favourites. These are our ten favourites right now. Each one says what kind of shooter it is and roughly how long the main story takes. The full list of shooters follows.

What counts as a shooter

A shooter is any game where aiming and shooting is the heart of the action. That covers first-person shooters, where you see through your character's eyes, third-person shooters where you see them on screen, and top-down and arcade shooters.

The full list includes every game on PS Plus tagged as a shooter, which takes in some adventure and RPG games where gunplay is a big part, like Uncharted and Fallout.

1

DOOM Eternal

First-person shooter · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 87 · 95% recommend on OpenCritic · about 14 h main story

The Doom Slayer takes on the forces of Hell on a ruined Earth, and the game never stops moving. It's a fast, loud and brilliantly designed combat puzzle where you're always juggling weapons and ammo.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Uncharted 4: A Thief's End

Third-person action adventure · PS4 · Metascore 93 · 97% recommend on OpenCritic · about 15 h main story

Nathan Drake is pulled out of retirement for one last treasure hunt, following a lost pirate colony across the world. It's an action movie you play, with big set pieces, great characters and gunfights that flow into climbing and chases.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus

First-person shooter · PS4 · Metascore 87 · about 11 h main story

B.J. Blazkowicz leads a resistance against the Nazi regime ruling an alternate 1960s America. It's a brutal shooter with a surprisingly funny, emotional story and some of the strangest scenes in the genre.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Helldivers 2

Co-op third-person shooter · PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 33 h main story

You and up to three friends drop onto alien planets to spread “managed democracy” for Super Earth, with friendly fire always on and orbital strikes on call. It's chaotic, very funny and best with a squad.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Returnal

Roguelike third-person shooter · PS5 · Metascore 86 · about 19 h main story

A space pilot crash-lands on a hostile alien planet and relives the same run every time she dies. The bullet-hell combat is intense and precise, and each run teaches you something new.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Far Cry 3 Classic Edition

Open-world first-person shooter · PS4 · Metascore 88 · 67% recommend on OpenCritic · about 16 h main story

Jason Brody's holiday goes horribly wrong when pirates take his friends captive on an island run by the unforgettable Vaas. It set the open-world template the series has followed ever since.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Metro 2033 Redux

Survival horror shooter · PS4 / PS5 · Needs Premium · Metascore 90 · 81% recommend on OpenCritic · about 9.1 h main story

The survivors of a nuclear war live in Moscow's metro tunnels, and you're sent out into the dark to save them. It's tense and atmospheric, with scarce ammo and gas-mask filters running out.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

TimeSplitters 2

PS2 first-person shooter · PS4 / PS5 · Needs Premium · Metascore 90 · about 7.1 h main story

A time-travelling shooter from former GoldenEye developers, with fast story levels and some of the best split-screen multiplayer ever made.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Abiotic Factor

Co-op survival shooter · PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 44 h main story

An experiment goes wrong at an underground research lab, and a team of scientists has to survive the monsters, soldiers and portal creatures that pour in. It's a funny co-op survival game with a 1990s sci-fi shooter feel.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Hotline Miami

Top-down shooter · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 85 · about 5.2 h main story

A masked hitman clears 1980s Miami buildings room by room in a top-down blur of violence and neon. One hit kills you and one hit kills them, and the soundtrack is superb.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

Questions

What's the best shooter on PS Plus?

By Metascore, The Last of Us Part II Remastered and Uncharted 4, both at 93. For pure first-person shooting, DOOM Eternal.

What are the best co-op shooters on PS Plus?

Helldivers 2 and Abiotic Factor are built for co-op, and Back 4 Blood and World War Z are four-player zombie shooters. Our online co-op list has more.

Are there Call of Duty games on PS Plus?

Some have been in the catalogue. They come and go, so check the wall for what's there now.

What's a good shooter for beginners?

Uncharted 4 has gentle difficulty options and is easy to follow, and Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart is a friendly, colourful shooter for all ages.

Are there classic shooters on PS Plus Premium?

Yes, including TimeSplitters 2, Syphon Filter, Metro 2033 Redux and DOOM 3. Our Premium classics list has more.
